Name: Source
Subject: claim, evidence
Pass: the book is in the store with an origin and a licence (score 0.8 when the transcription is unverified)
Fail: unknown book, or no origin or licence

Name: Transcription
Subject: claim, evidence
Pass: a verified manual transcription, or OCR confidence ≥ 0.9
Warn: an unverified transcription, or OCR confidence 0.7–0.9

Name: Philology
Subject: claim, evidence
Pass: text collated against an edition, and the span not on a contested reading
Warn: uncollated text, or a contested reading whose base reading has p ≥ 0.4
Fail: the span rests on a contested reading with p < 0.4

Name: Sense
Subject: claim; hypothesis
Pass: every term resolved to one sense for its period
Warn: a homonym whose most likely sense has p < 0.6

Name: Claim provenance
Subject: claim, evidence; hypothesis
Pass: the quote is verbatim at its span and states the relation
Warn: verbatim, but the quote does not clearly state the relation, or states a view the author rejects
Fail: the quote is not verbatim or not where it is said to be, or it contradicts the claim

Name: Independent sources
Subject: hypothesis
Pass: supporting evidence from ≥ 2 independent source families (the contract may ask for more)

Name: Falsification
Subject: hypothesis
Pass: the latest Skeptic review leaves no open critical or major objection
Fail: an open critical objection (pending before any review)

Name: Expert
Subject: hypothesis
Fail: a named expert rejects (pending until then)

Name: Modern evidence
Subject: hypothesis (biomedical or bridge claims)
Pass: records in people support a biomedical claim; any modern record contextualizes a typed bridge
Fail: no modern record, or a record contradicts the claim; not applicable to historical hypotheses
